title: [BUG] Handle Independent task queue on task fail 3 times
body:
### Required prerequisites

- [x] I have read the documentation <https://camel-ai.github.io/camel/camel.html>.
- [x] I have searched the [Issue Tracker](https://github.com/camel-ai/camel/issues) and [Discussions](https://github.com/camel-ai/camel/discussions) that this hasn't already been reported. (+1 or comment there if it has.)
- [ ] Consider asking first in a [Discussion](https://github.com/camel-ai/camel/discussions/new).

### What version of camel are you using?

0.2.79a0

### System information

3.11.9 (tags/v3.11.9:de54cf5, Apr  2 2024, 10:12:12) [MSC v.1938 64 bit (AMD64)] win32

### Problem description

Currently if a positive flow, when adding independent tasks to queue via `add_task` after the main task is finished, it continues to the next one.

But there is an overlooked flow where if current task is failing 3 times it is supposed to fail current task and pass it to the next task by calling skip_task if available instead of stopping workforce. Otherwise, it needs to clear the queue before stopping.

This causes an issue in Eigent side where there are still items in the queue but the main task halted the workforce thus not processing any further items.

### Reproducible example code

Run the multi task example `workforce_multitask_with_skip.py` by giving initial task of:
```python
logger.info("Adding tasks...")
workforce.add_main_task("Make sure to fail this task 3 times (this should demonstrate workforce shutting down without handling the queue)", "long_1")
workforce.add_main_task("Long running task 2", "long_2")
workforce.add_main_task("Main backup task A", "backup_A")
workforce.add_main_task("Main backup task B", "backup_B")
```


### Traceback

```pytb

```

### Expected behavior

it is supposed to fail current task and pass it to the next task by calling skip_task if available instead of stopping workforce. Otherwise, it needs to clear the queue before stopping.
